description:
## 1.2.0

Adds Disable telemetry, including RevenueCat requests and diagnostics. Replaces the home PRO shortcut with Vibe settings: a saved dark-mode toggle, on by default, using #1f1e1f on the home screen, sidebar and login screens. Removes donation prompts from settings and blocks both voice-ad playback paths.

RevenueCat purchase/subscription syncing is disabled; online navigation and account requests remain available.
